t: 徽宗皇帝让位给他的儿子钦宗皇帝。
te: Emperor Huizong abdicates the Chinese throne in favour of his son Emperor Qinzong.
dz: 徽宗皇帝让位给他的儿子钦宗皇帝。
de: Emperor Huizong abdicates the Chinese throne in favour of his son Emperor Qinzong.

t: 在他的母亲莱昂王后乌拉卡去世后,阿方索七世被封为莱昂国王.
te: Following the death of his mother, queen Urraca of León, Alfonso VII is proclaimed king of León.
dz: 在他的母亲莱昂王后乌拉卡去世后,阿方索七世被封为莱昂国王.
